format: Team Rocket (TR, 2000): cards not already in the pool. Unlimited only.

attacks.name: Teleport Blast
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Stare
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. If that Pokémon has a Pokémon Power, that power stops working until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Poison Vapor
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned. Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hydrocannon
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Rocket Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself. Flip a coin. On heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Continuous Fireball
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads. Discard a number of Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokémon equal to the number of heads.

abilities.name: Summon Minions
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand, look through your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Giant Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Sinkhole
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, your opponent flips a coin. On tails, this power does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Knock Down
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a coin. On tails, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if heads, this attack does 20 damage.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you do, this Pokémon does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Apply Weakness and Resistance.

attacks.name: Flitter
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Bench Manipulation
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a number of coins equal to the number of Pokémon on their Bench. This attack does 20 damage times the number of tails. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Fling
attacks.text: Your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sonicboom
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Magnetic Lines
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any basic Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them. If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and attach that Energy card to it.

abilities.name: Reel In
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand, choose up to 3 Basic Pokémon cards and/or Evolution cards from your discard pile and put them into your hand.

attacks.name: Fickle Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Hay Fever
abilities.text: No Trainer cards can be played. This power stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Petal Whirlwind
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, this Pokémon becomes Confused (after doing damage).

attacks.name: Mass Explosion
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the total number of Koffing, Weezing and Dark Weezing in play (apply Weakness and Resistance). Then, this attack does 20 damage to each Koffing, Weezing and Dark Weezing (even your own). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this damage.

attacks.name: Stun Gas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned; if tails, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fireball
attacks.text: Use this attack only if there are any Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokémon. Flip a coin. On heads, discard 1 of those Energy cards. On tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

abilities.name: Evolutionary Light
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look through your deck for an Evolution card. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Tail Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Energy Bomb
attacks.text: Take all Energy cards attached to this Pokémon and attach them to your Benched Pokémon (in any way you choose). If you have no Benched Pokémon, discard all Energy cards attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Playing with Fire
attacks.text: Use this attack only if there are any Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokémon. Flip a coin. On heads, discard 1 of those Energy cards and this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.

abilities.name: Pollen Stench
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Confused; if tails, your Active Pokémon becomes Confused. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Third Eye
attacks.text: Discard 1 Energy card attached to this Pokémon in order to draw up to 3 cards.

attacks.name: Lightning Flash
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. On tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Thunder Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed. On tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Matter Exchange
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a card from your hand in order to draw a card. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. Do the damage to the new Defending Pokémon. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Knock Back
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, they choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Sticky Goo
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent pays ColorlessColorless more to retreat their Active Pokémon. This power stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Sludge Punch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Fascinate
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon does any damage while it's Confused (even to itself), it does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Frenzied Attack
attacks.text: This Pokémon becomes Confused (after doing damage).

attacks.name: Flame Pillar
attacks.text: You may discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon when you use this attack. If you do and your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Mirror Shell
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), this Pokémon attacks the Defending Pokémon for an equal amount of damage.

attacks.name: Rapid Evolution
attacks.text: Look through your deck for an Evolution card named Gyarados or Dark Gyarados and put it on this Pokémon. (This counts as evolving this Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Conversion 1
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has a Weakness, you may change it to a type of your choice other than Colorless.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Vanish
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon into your deck. (Discard all cards attached to this Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Gather Fire
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Fire Energy card attached to 1 of your other Pokémon and attach it to this Pokémon. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Hyper Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Dig Under
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Long-Distance Hypnosis
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep; if tails, your Active Pokémon becomes Asleep. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep.

attacks.name: Sand-attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. On tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep.

attacks.name: Sticky Hands
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Magnetism
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Magnemite, Magneton and Dark Magneton on your Bench.

attacks.name: Mischief
attacks.text: Shuffle your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Anger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Coin Hurl
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Dizziness
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

abilities.name: Trickery
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch 1 of your Prize cards with the top card of your deck. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Afternoon Nap
attacks.text: Look through your deck for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Surprise Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, flip another coin. If the second coin is heads, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If the second coin is tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Rocket's Sneak Attack
cards.text: Look at your opponent's hand. If they have any Trainer cards there, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into their deck.

cards.name: Rainbow Energy
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, it counts as every type of basic Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (It doesn't count as a basic Energy card when not in play.) When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, it does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

cards.name: The Boss's Way
cards.text: Look through your deck for an Evolution card with "Dark" in its name. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Challenge!
cards.text: Ask your opponent if they accept your challenge. If your opponent declines (or if both Benches are full), draw 2 cards. If your opponent accepts, each of you searches your deck for any number of Basic Pokémon and puts them face down onto your Bench. (A player can't do this if their Bench is full.) When you have both finished, shuffle your decks and turn those cards face up.

cards.name: Digger
cards.text: Flip a coin. On tails, do 10 damage to your Active Pokémon. On heads, your opponent flips a coin. On tails, your opponent does 10 damage to their Active Pokémon. On heads, you flip a coin. Keep doing this until a player gets tails.

cards.name: Imposter Oak's Revenge
cards.text: Discard a card from your hand in order to play this card. Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck, then draws 4 cards.

cards.name: Nightly Garbage Run
cards.text: Choose up to 3 Basic Pokémon cards, Evolution cards and/or basic Energy cards from your discard pile. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

cards.name: Goop Gas Attack
cards.text: All Pokémon Powers stop working until the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Sleep!
cards.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep.

cards.name: Full Heal Energy
cards.text: If you play this card from your hand, the Pokémon you attach it to is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed or Poisoned. This card provides 1 Colorless Energy. (It doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Potion Energy
cards.text: If you play this card from your hand, remove 1 damage counter from the Pokémon you attach it to, if it has any. This card provides 1 Colorless Energy. (It doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)
